<a id="myapp-job-duration-note-1"></a>**[1]:** Measured from when the job is taken from the queue until it completes.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`myapp.job.queue`](/myapp/README.md#myapp-job-queue) | ![Stable](https://img.shields.io/badge/-stable-lightgreen) | `Required` | string | Name of the queue the job was taken from. Case-sensitive. | `default` |
| [`myapp.job.id`](/myapp/README.md#myapp-job-id) | ![Stable](https://img.shields.io/badge/-stable-lightgreen) | `Conditionally Required` [[2]](#myapp-job-duration-note-2) | string | Identifier of the job. [[2]](#myapp-job-duration-note-2) | `job-42` |
| [`myapp.job.attempt`](/myapp/README.md#myapp-job-attempt) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | int | Attempt number, starting at 1. [[3]](#myapp-job-duration-note-3) | `1`; `3` |

<a id="myapp-job-duration-note-2"></a>**[2] `myapp.job.id`:**

**Requirement level:** When the scheduler assigns an identifier to the job.

**Note:** The identifier is assigned by the scheduler and stays the same across retries of the same job.

<a id="myapp-job-duration-note-3"></a>**[3] `myapp.job.attempt`:** Instrumentations that cannot see retries done by the scheduler report 1 for every attempt.
